newsitem.title: USA: Headway acquisitions may boost EPS -report.
newsitem.headline: Headway acquisitions may boost EPS -report.

text.p: Headway Corp Resources Inc, a company that provides staffing services to the financial industry, could be announcing acquisitions that will boost its revenues and earnings, BusinessWeek said Thursday.
The magazine said in its latest edition that the company is likely to announce three acquisitions that should push revenues to $147 million by year's end, up from $57 million.
It said the acquisitions are expected to contribute $0.10 a share to this year's earnings and more in 1998.
BusinessWeek said Headway chief executive Gary Goldstein acknowledges major acquisitions are in the works.
